descripcion: A vulnerability was found in Michael-A-Kuykendall Shimmy up to 2.6.4. The affected element is an unknown function of the file src/server.rs of the component Inference API. Performing a manipulation results in missing authentication. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. Upgrading to version 2.6.5 is sufficient to fix this issue. The patch is named 3f2ee748c02eeb229987913fe289a2ed9a24595d. A security flaw has been discovered in sunkaifei FlyCMS up to e71738e0cfb7ffd48c2ce74242a2dbb43f84f25a. Affected by this vulnerability is the function ModelDataService.insertData of the file articles/detail.html of the component Content Rendering. Performing a manipulation of the argument content results in cross site scripting. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. Continious delivery with rolling releases is used by this product. Therefore, no version details of affected nor updated releases are available. The patch is named 714521a9262e7bc9ca5713c873f57e96a4845352. It is recommended to apply a patch to fix this issue. 10/11/2026 10/11/2026 Vector CVSS:4.0 CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:L/UI:P/VC:N/VI:L/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:P/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N Vector CVSS:2.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:S/C:N/I:P/A:N Gravedad 4.0 2.00 Gravedad 4.0 txt LOW Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 3.50 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) LOW

A vulnerability was determined in D-Link DCS-6501LH 3.03.02. This impacts the function pf_get_onvif_user_pwd/mydlink_default_sys_info of the file /mnt/conf/SystemConfig.ini of the component Media Service. This manipulation of the argument pin_code causes hard-coded credentials. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely.
